data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 20.2m (2018: GBP 65.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 1.2m (2018: improvement of GBP 4.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on a number of classes with partially offsetting favourable developments on the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty classes.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 1.2 million in 2019. This deterioration was primarily driven by unfavourable developments across a number of classes, although these were partially offset by favourable developments in the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty classes. Overall, the Syndicate experienced adverse actual vs expected claims experience, including increased attritional claims activity in the Motor Warranty book within the Consumer Products portfolio and a rise in large losses reported by the 1861-led Casualty consortium.
raw_causal_phrases: unfavourable developments on a number of classes
partially offsetting favourable developments on the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty classes
adverse actual vs expected claims experience
increase in the number of large losses reported

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Direct Insurance: Fire & other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of GBP 1.2m is inferred to be NET of reinsurance, as it is stated as 'included within net claims incurred'. No explicit gross prior year development figure was available. The sum of individual gross premium mix items does not exactly match the total gross premiums written in the segmental analysis table, likely due to rounding in the source document. The claims development table only shows one underwriting year (2017), which is unusual for a full triangle, likely due to the syndicate ceasing underwriting and the RITC adjustment.
